Legislation label for Section 60 searches

Source: R/ingest-stops.R
lamp_s60_legislation.Rd

The exact string that data.police.uk uses in the Legislation column of stop-and-search files for searches under section 60 of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 (verified 2026-09-16).

Usage

lamp_s60_legislation()

Value

A string.

See also

Other ingest: lamp_archive_download(), lamp_archive_index(), lamp_archive_register(), lamp_archive_snapshot(), lamp_list_versions(), lamp_lsoa_vintage(), lamp_read_crime(), lamp_read_outcomes(), lamp_read_stop_counts(), lamp_select_version(), lamp_version_diff()

Examples

lamp_s60_legislation()
#> [1] "Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 (section 60)"
